data.text: Good, I can see the structure. Now I'll run a SQL query to calculate the average number of items per order, following the plan: filter out canceled and unavailable orders, then compute the average.

args.purpose: Calculate average number of items per valid order (excluding canceled and unavailable)
args.sql:
SELECT 
  COUNT(order_item_id) as total_items,
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) as total_orders,
  ROUND(COUNT(order_item_id)::NUMERIC / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) as avg_items_per_order
FROM order_items
JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id
WHERE orders.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
